rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement structure (flooring, drywall) and contents (boxes) resulting from a burst pipe in their own plumbing system is standard homeowners property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement flooded due to a burst bathroom supply line that ran for approximately two days while the policyholder was away. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, drywall soaked up to one foot high, and ruined stored boxes across the entire basement. High-severity claim requiring urgent water mitigation and structural assessment.

case_facts.water_depth: approximately two inches across entire basement
case_facts.damage_description: hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to about one foot high, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days

rationale: Wind-caused damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles) is direct property damage to the home, covered under the homeowners_premium policy.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee reports wind damage to the back porch roof overhang, with approximately four shingles blown off. No water intrusion or secondary damage reported. Estimated repair cost is $400.

case_facts.description: wind blew approximately four shingles off overhang above back porch
case_facts.secondary_damage: none - no water intrusion or other damage reported
